sentence: She is going to start a new job next month
hint: be + going to + base verb for plans
explanation: Going to para el futuro planeado: sujeto + be + going to + verbo base.

sentence: I will call you when I arrive
hint: Will for promises and spontaneous decisions
explanation: 'Will' para promesas. Nota: después de 'when', se usa el presente 'arrive', no el futuro.

sentence: You should see a doctor about that cough
explanation: El modal 'should' + forma base para dar consejos: 'should see'.

sentence: They might come to the party tonight
explanation: 'Might' + forma base para posibilidad: 'might come'.

sentence: We are meeting the clients at three tomorrow
explanation: Presente continuo para el futuro programado: 'are meeting'.

sentence: He must finish the report before Friday
explanation: 'Must' + forma base para obligación: 'must finish'.

sentence: You should not eat so much sugar
explanation: 'Should not' para consejo negativo. 'Must' sería demasiado fuerte aquí.

sentence: I am going to travel to Japan next summer
explanation: Going to para el futuro planeado: 'am going to travel'.

sentence: She can speak three languages fluently
explanation: 'Can' + forma base para habilidad. El adverbio 'fluently' va al final.

sentence: It will probably rain this afternoon
hint: Adverbs go between will and the main verb
explanation: 'Probably' se coloca entre 'will' y el verbo: 'will probably rain'.

sentence: You must not use your phone during the exam
explanation: 'Must not' para prohibición: 'must not use'.

sentence: They could arrive late because of the traffic
explanation: 'Could' + forma base para posibilidad: 'could arrive'.

sentence: We will have finished the project by December
hint: Future perfect: will + have + past participle
explanation: Futuro perfecto para indicar que algo estará terminado antes de un plazo: 'will have finished'.

sentence: She might not be able to come tomorrow
explanation: 'Might not' para posibilidad negativa. 'Be able to' reemplaza a 'can' después de otro modal.

sentence: You should have told me about the problem earlier
hint: Should have + past participle for past regret
explanation: 'Should have + participio pasado' para cosas que era aconsejable hacer pero no ocurrieron.

sentence: I will definitely be there on time
explanation: El adverbio 'definitely' va entre 'will' y el verbo: 'will definitely be'.

sentence: He is going to apply for the scholarship next week
explanation: Going to para intenciones: 'is going to apply'.

sentence: We must leave now or we will miss the train
explanation: Dos cláusulas: 'must leave now' (obligación) + 'will miss' (consecuencia).

sentence: She could have been a professional dancer
hint: Could have + past participle for unrealized past ability
explanation: 'Could have been' para algo posible en el pasado que no ocurrió.

sentence: They are not going to accept the offer
explanation: Going to en negativo: 'are not going to accept'.

sentence: You may use the computer after lunch
explanation: 'May' + forma base para permiso: 'may use'.

sentence: I will be working at the office all day tomorrow
explanation: Futuro continuo para acciones futuras en desarrollo: 'will be working'.

sentence: He should not have spent all his money
explanation: 'Should not have + participio pasado' para arrepentimiento sobre algo que sí ocurrió.

sentence: We might go to the mountains this weekend
explanation: 'Might' para planes inciertos: 'might go'.

sentence: You will need to bring your passport to the airport
explanation: 'Will need to' para necesidad futura.

sentence: The train is about to leave the station
hint: be about to + base verb for the very near future
explanation: 'Be about to' expresa un futuro inmediato: algo va a pasar en cuestión de segundos o minutos.

sentence: By next year, she will have finished her degree
hint: will have + past participle for actions completed before a future point
explanation: Futuro perfecto: will + have + participio, para una acción completada antes de un momento futuro.

sentence: We must finish this report by Friday
explanation: 'Must' expresa obligación fuerte, seguido del verbo base sin 'to'.

sentence: Shall we meet outside the cinema at seven
hint: Shall we...? is used for suggestions
explanation: 'Shall we...?' se usa para hacer sugerencias educadas sobre planes futuros.

sentence: I have to renew my passport before the trip
explanation: 'Have to' expresa una obligación externa, a diferencia de 'must' que suele ser más personal.
